sec.title: September 2 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 581)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 2** across monumental historic V-J Day victory celebrations, Latin-American musical comedy revues, deductive clerical detective drama, fast-paced police thrillers, adventure serials, and celebrity bond drives, the historic AFRS *Command Performance V-J Day Special* featuring Bing Crosby, Frank Sinatra, and Bob Hope (1945), Carmen Miranda and Keenan Wynn on *The Chase and Sanborn Program* (1945), Karl Swenson as *Father Brown* (1945), *Call the Police* for Lever Brothers (1947), *I Love a Mystery* (1952), and *Guest Star* (1945–1952):
